content: ग्रासः [ग्रस् कर्मणि घञ्] .²1 A mouthful, a quantity of anything equal to a mouthful; <ls>Ms. 3. 133</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 28</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 55</ls>. .²2 Food, nourishment; ग्रासाच्छादनमात्रं तु दद्यादिति निदर्शनम् <ls>Mb. 12. 165. 63</ls>. .²3 The part of the sun or the moon eclipsed. .²4 The morsel bitten. .²5 The act of swallowing. .²6 Slurring, indistinct pronunciation; fault in a pronunciation of the gutturals. .²7 (In <ab>geom.</ab>) A piece cut out by the intersection of two circles 8 An eclipse.
